standard_prerequisites.name: Full faithfulness of an adjoint whose unit or counit is an isomorphism
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Categories, the lemma that a functor with a left adjoint whose counit is an isomorphism is fully faithful and the subsequent statement identifying the adjunction when both maps are isomorphisms
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies the conclusion that pi^{-1} is fully faithful when Rpi_* pi^{-1} = id, and then that the counit pi_! pi^{-1} -> id is an isomorphism.

core_obligations: Case of an initial object (proof lines 10195-10198): if the site has an initial object then the lower shriek pi_! is computed by evaluating on that object, so the composite Lpi_! composed with pi^{-1} is the identity on D(Ab), respectively on D(B).

Case of a final object (proof lines 10198-10202): if the site has a final object then the pushforward Rpi_* is computed by evaluating on that object, hence Rpi_* pi^{-1} is isomorphic to the identity on D(Ab), respectively on D(B).

Conclude by formal adjunction theory (proof lines 10202-10205): the isomorphism Rpi_* pi^{-1} = id says that the unit of the adjunction is an isomorphism, so the pullback is fully faithful by the cited lemma, and the same lemma then gives that the counit Lpi_! pi^{-1} -> id is an isomorphism as well, which is the assertion.
proof_roadmap: Compute the shriek or the pushforward by evaluation on the initial or final object.
In the remaining case use the resulting identification of the unit to get full faithfulness and hence the identification of the counit.
difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that in the situation of the example of the category mapping to the point, if the site has an initial or a final object then the composite of the lower shriek with the pullback is the identity on the derived category of abelian groups, respectively of B-modules (statement lines 10188-10193). The proof (proof lines 10195-10206) disposes of the initial object case by evaluating the shriek, then uses the evaluation of the pushforward on a final object to obtain Rpi_* pi^{-1} = id and concludes by the formal criterion for full faithfulness of an adjoint. H2: two cases with one formal adjunction step, written out in full.
